chunks: From him, from Ja'far, from Muthannā, from Manṣūr ibn Ḥāzim, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Pray the ʿAṣr prayer at four feet. Al-Muthannā said: Abū Baṣīr said to me: Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said to me: Pray the ʿAṣr prayer on Friday at six feet.

key_terms.أَرْبَعَةِ أَقْدَامٍ: A measure of shadow length used to determine prayer time
key_terms.سِتَّةِ أَقْدَامٍ: A measure of shadow length specified here for Friday

ai.seo_question: When should the ʿAṣr prayer be prayed according to this hadith from al-Istibsar?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the time of the ʿAṣr prayer. It states that ʿAṣr is prayed at four feet, and on Friday it is prayed at six feet, indicating a distinction in prayer timing within fiqh discussions on the end of Zuhr and the beginning of ʿAṣr.
